newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet prices steady to firmer in balanced trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet prices steady to firmer in balanced trade.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices were steady in quiet trade on Friday in line with benchmark gas oil futures and with a slight improvement in barge and cargo premiums following quotes related trade on Thursday.

Traders said most prompt requirements were covered on Thursday and the market was better balanced with one or two buyers still looking for product and little sign of resale cargoes as a result of the British Airways strike.
Barges were pegged around 50 cents to $1 firmer at August IPE +$15/16 a tonne fob ARA with cargoes up a similar amount at August IPE +$16/+$17 a tonne cif NWE.
At 1148 GMT benchmark August IPE gas oil futures were trading unchanged at $161.75 a tonne.
